summary: Successfully implemented ReadOnlyView for MeteredKeyValueStore (KAFKA-20497). Added readOnly(IsolationLevel) method to MeteredKeyValueStore that returns a MeteredReadOnlyView wrapper. The wrapper applies serdes and records metrics for all read operations (get, range, reverseRange, all, reverseAll, prefixScan) while delegating to the inner store's read-only view. The implementation passes all test cases including metric recording and null pointer validation.
